issue.title: test_candidates_fast_path_child_cpu_budget[snippet] exceeds 250ms CPU under the full parallel lane
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/main/test_completion_candidates_contract.py::test_candidates_fast_path_child_cpu_budget[snippet]`
- **Repro:** `.venv/bin/pytest tests/main/test_completion_candidates_contract.py::test_candidates_fast_path_child_cpu_budget -q --tb=line`

Child CPU budget is 250.0 ms. Under the full parallel `just check` lane it failed with best-of-two timings `[0.348, 0.259]` (AssertionError: 259.3 < 250.0). Tool run `980bb79cc98e69e3cefab0bcdfcfe062` on 2026-10-04; the suite had escalated via `core-identity-changed`.

The same node passed in isolation on the same tree (22 parametrized cases, including `[snippet]`, 16.69s). Other kinds stayed under budget even in the failing full run.

Unrelated to ACE restart-wait launch blockers. This is a load-sensitive CPU-budget assertion, not a product regression.

task_type_fields.evidence: Full parallel just check failed with best-of-two CPU timings [0.348, 0.259] against a 250ms budget. Isolation on the same tree passed all parametrized kinds including snippet. Unrelated to ACE restart-wait launch blockers.

issue.creation_reason: Discovered during restart-wait just check: the snippet CPU-budget probe failed under full parallel load and passed in isolation on the same tree.

payload.description: sibling completion-candidates budget flake on wall-clock rather than child CPU
